reviews.title: Good for 4070 Super
reviews.comment: Run this on my 4070S and it is good, but I don't understand how this is shown to be compatible with the 4080/4090. My 4080 came with a 3 to 1 adapter and this is only 2 to 1. It would probably work with a 4080 if you don't push the power limits but I wouldn't trust it with a 4090 and definitely not much more than 300-400 watts. It is actually a little flimsy which is fine for tucking it away but makes me wonder if the gauge wires are even to spec. I known anyone with a 4090 with probably get an ATX 3.0 PSU which is what I have for my 4080 and peace of mind..
